pt.summary: Olá! Sou o João, programador no Porto, Portugal. Trabalho atualmente na BLIP, onde desenvolvo backend para a FanDuel. Antes disso, passei pela Critical TechWorks, onde desenvolvi software para a BMW, incluindo a Loja Online da BMW, um produto de grande escala com muitos utilizadores em vários países. Tenho experiência em frontend e backend, com tecnologias como Java, TypeScript e Angular.

entries.title: Estágio Curricular
details: Reconstrução de raiz do website da empresa em Angular e NodeJS, um portal que liga o público aos profissionais do setor dos casamentos. O foco foi um sistema de mensagens entre o público e os profissionais e a criação de anúncios por área de negócio e distrito, para o público não ter de contactar os profissionais um a um.

en.summary: Hi! I'm João, a software developer based in Porto, Portugal. I currently work at BLIP, developing backend software for FanDuel. Before that I worked at Critical TechWorks building software for BMW, including the BMW Online Shop, a large-scale product with a high volume of users across many countries. I have experience in both frontend and backend, with technologies such as Java, TypeScript and Angular.

projects.name: Mission Control Center
projects.details: A small Angular project to watch several YouTube videos at once in a grid view.

entries.title: BMW Material Management
details: Development of an application to support material managers in BMW plants.

entries.title: BMW Shop
details: Development of the BMW Online Shop, focusing on the product list and later on the checkout process.

entries.title: Internal tools
details: Development of internal tools to support the company's personal development process and company car reservations.

entries.title: Professional Internship
details: Continuation of the curricular internship project, developing Ionic mobile apps for users to access their account dashboard.

entries.title: Curricular Internship
details: Rebuild of the company website from scratch with Angular and NodeJS, a portal connecting the public with professionals from the wedding sector. The focus was a messaging system between the public and the professionals, and announcements by business area and district, so the public didn't have to contact professionals one by one.
